Founders don't grow in a straight line. They grow one notch at a time.

Club Notch is a small, in-person gathering for young founders and next-gen family business builders who'd rather figure things out with people in the room than alone with a spreadsheet.

See what's next Meet the community
where it started

We built the thing we needed ourselves.

The three of us kept circling the same frustration — none of us had anyone to turn to. No mentor down the hall, no friend who'd actually built something. Just three people figuring it out alone.

Club Notch is the fix: a running series of small, in-person gatherings for founders who want exactly what we didn't have — people in their corner who actually get it. Every gathering since has been a notch higher than the last.

from the room

What people say after they leave.

I walked in expecting another networking event. I walked out with an actual co-founder for a side project.
No one was trying to sell me anything. Everyone was just genuinely stuck on the same things I was.
It's the only founder event I've been to where the best conversation happened after the "official" bit ended.
I came in with one problem I'd been sitting on for weeks. Left with three people who'd already solved it.
Small enough that I actually remember everyone's name. That never happens at these things.
